translate_en|mods/WanderingHordes28DaysL: Time-dependent zombie behavior and spawn chance multiplier

What spread will be taken into account when moving toward the player (player direction is base in formula). The default value is 110 degrees. Set it lower so they head straight toward you (homing). Set it higher so they move in a more random direction
If turned off, this mod won't work
If there any player in this radius, zombie could make route through house. Outside this radius zombie won't go through the house, it will go around side.
Final day of distribution across the map
Day when passability and final population multiplier reaches final day value. Set to 0 for final distribution state from day 0.

The passability value gradually approaches from start value to this value by the final day. For example: If the final day is 14, then on day 7 the value will be between of the starting and final values. Start value 0.50 and Final day value 0.72 = 0.61 on day 7.

The passability value gradually approaches from start value to this value by the final day. For example: If the final day is 14, then on day 7 the value will be the between of the starting and final values. Start value 0.50 and Final day value 0.72 = 0.61 on day 7.
Final day spawn chance multiplier in %%

Multiplies city spawn chances by this value towards the final day. Day 0 value is 100%. For example: if value of this setting is 30 and final day is 14, on day 0 you will have 100% multiplier, on day 7 it's 65% multiplier, and on day 14 it's 30% multiplier. Doesn't affect minimal spawn chance
Works everywhere on the map, independent of chunk spawn chance distributed from cities. Multiplies with chunk spawn chance
Turn On/Off spawn chance check button
You can check spawn chance in context menu in the game. Default is turned on
How far will the zombies travel from their spawn point. Always set this value to be greater than the spawn distance; otherwise, the zombies will disappear before they reach you.
If zombies wasn't spawned for this time, they will be spawned guaranteed
How wide the wandering horde spawn formation is. Higher values make the horde look less like a single clump.
At what distance mod zombies will become physically rendered. Further away they will be virtually calculated. Put lower value if you have betterFPS installed.
Vanilla value: means a random percent of sprinters from the vanilla Random sprinters amount value, all zombie sprinters toggle, or none of them. Sprinters percent: takes the value from the line below
